record_window: All records available at one discovery session snapshot after freeze; no publication-date exclusion. Record UTC retrieval time; no later requery.
stopping_rule: One query per provider/label (20 total), snapshot count<=100/provider. >100 total returns from either provider voids label as overflow before reviews. No narrowing/paging rescue or transport retry. Metadata fetch all<=100, deduplicate versioned accessions/provider aliases. Sort metadata by reviewed UniProt first, unreviewed UniProt second, RefSeq third, then accession ASCII, sequence version ascending. Cap primary accession reviews to first20 sorted records/label, fixed before opening sequence/domain evidence. First all-A-E passer is provisionally chosen; no candidate21 if first20 fail. Operational failures permanent. Finish every label, disclose unused reviewed records and cap failures.
enrollment: Exactly one provisional query per label (max10), then lexical-label global90%identity/80%coverage cheap duplicate clustering. Connected components, retain lexical first(label,accession) from each; no replacement after exclusion. Not genomic-locus independence. Controls assigned afterward deterministically from fixed pre-discovery pool. Real-control matching is applied ONLY to retained enrolled query sequences with their actual lengths; unmatched labels stay in primary count. Minimum matchedM5 is an unpowered descriptive reporting threshold.
